title: Odisha cyber police arrest three men from Delhi over online investment fraud of Rs 29.54 lakh
date_note: Orissa Post gives only its own publication day, 25 November, and says officials spoke on Wednesday; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: Orissa Post reports that Odisha cyber police arrested three men from West Delhi in an online investment fraud. A retired private-sector employee in Bhubaneswar, lured through social media with promises of high returns, was cheated of Rs 29.54 lakh, according to the report. Police are searching for the holder of the bank account that received the money.
plain: Orissa Post says Odisha cyber police arrested three men from Delhi over an online investment scam in which a retired man from Bhubaneswar lost Rs 29.54 lakh.
exec: Orissa Post reports an arrest in an online investment fraud that cost one victim Rs 29.54 lakh.
geo_basis: Complaint filed at Lingaraj police station, Bhubaneswar, per Orissa Post

validation.note: Only Orissa Post read; it relays the police account. No police page read.
